1: -module(quod_peer_capacity_SUITE).
    2: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
    3: -export([all/0, init_per_suite/1, end_per_suite/1, init_per_testcase/2,
    4:          acquired_contact_is_retained_before_loss_subscription/1,
    5:          last_consumer_death_releases_capacity/1,
    6:          dead_queued_acquisition_preserves_capacity_wakeup/1,
    7:          withdrawn_contact_releases_waiting_observers/1,
    8:          idle_contact_survives_until_acquisition_pressure/1,
    9:          node_key_rotation_replaces_the_retained_slot/1]).
   10: 
   11: all() -> [acquired_contact_is_retained_before_loss_subscription,
   12:           last_consumer_death_releases_capacity,
   13:           dead_queued_acquisition_preserves_capacity_wakeup,
   14:           withdrawn_contact_releases_waiting_observers,
   15:           idle_contact_survives_until_acquisition_pressure,
   16:           node_key_rotation_replaces_the_retained_slot].
   17: 
   18: init_per_suite(Config) ->
   19:     application:load(quod),
   20:     Previous = application:get_env(quod, peer_observation_limit),
   21:     ok = application:set_env(quod, peer_observation_limit, 1),
   22:     [{previous_limit, Previous} | quod_quic_SUITE:init_per_suite(Config)].
   23: 
   24: end_per_suite(Config) ->
   25:     ok = quod_quic_SUITE:end_per_suite(Config),
   26:     case ?config(previous_limit, Config) of
   27:         undefined -> application:unset_env(quod, peer_observation_limit);
   28:         {ok, Value} -> application:set_env(quod, peer_observation_limit, Value)
   29:     end.
   30: 
   31: init_per_testcase(_, Config) ->
   32:     Sup = quod_reg:where({sup, node}),
   33:     ok = supervisor:terminate_child(Sup, quod_quic),
   34:     {ok, _} = supervisor:restart_child(Sup, quod_quic),
   35:     Config.
   36: 
   37: acquired_contact_is_retained_before_loss_subscription(_Config) ->
   38:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
   39:     {A, _} = install_contact(),
   40:     {B, _} = install_contact(),
   41:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
   42:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, B}),
   43:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T}),
   44:     try
   45:         {ok, Contact} = contact(T, A),
   46:         %% There is deliberately no peer_loss subscription yet. The route
   47:         %% interest already protects the just-acquired exact contact.
   48:         {blocked, capacity} = contact(T, B),
   49:         {ok, Contact} = contact(T, A),
   50:         %% A queued zero from a prior interest incarnation cannot release an
   51:         %% already renewed interest. The following reply is a processing fence.
   52:         T ! {gproc, resource_on_zero, l, {node_identity_route, A}, T},
   53:         {blocked, capacity} = contact(T, B),
   54:         receive
   55:             {peer_observation_capacity, T, available} -> ct:fail(stale_zero_woke_capacity)
   56:         after 0 -> ok
   57:         end,
   58:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
   59:         capacity_released(T),
   60:         {ok, _} = contact(T, B)
   61:     after
   62:         unsubscribe_if_present(A),
   63:         unsubscribe_if_present(B),
   64:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T})
   65:     end.
   66: 
   67: last_consumer_death_releases_capacity(_Config) ->
   68:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
   69:     {A, _} = install_contact(),
   70:     {B, _} = install_contact(),
   71:     Parent = self(),
   72:     {Consumer, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() ->
   73:         true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
   74:         {ok, C} = contact(T, A),
   75:         Parent ! {acquired, self(), C},
   76:         receive stop -> ok end
   77:     end),
   78:     receive {acquired, Consumer, _} -> ok
   79:     after 1000 -> ct:fail(consumer_not_acquired) end,
   80:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
   81:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, B}),
   82:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T}),
   83:     try
   84:         {blocked, capacity} = contact(T, B),
   85:         true = quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
   86:         %% Another ontology still depends on A: releasing only one consumer
   87:         %% must not permit pressure to evict the shared physical contact.
   88:         {blocked, capacity} = contact(T, B),
   89:         Consumer ! stop,
   90:         receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Consumer, normal} -> ok
   91:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(consumer_not_stopped) end,
   92:         capacity_released(T),
   93:         {ok, _} = contact(T, B)
   94:     after
   95:         Consumer ! stop,
   96:         unsubscribe_if_present(A),
   97:         unsubscribe_if_present(B),
   98:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T})
   99:     end.
  100: 
  101: dead_queued_acquisition_preserves_capacity_wakeup(_Config) ->
  102:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
  103:     {A, _} = install_contact(),
  104:     {B, _} = install_contact(),
  105:     {C, _} = install_contact(),
  106:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
  107:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, B}),
  108:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T}),
  109:     try
  110:         {ok, _} = contact(T, A),
  111:         {blocked, capacity} = contact(T, B),
  112:         ok = sys:suspend(T),
  113:         try
  114:             Parent = self(),
  115:             {Consumer, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() ->
  116:                 true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, C}),
  117:                 Ref = quod_quic:peer_contact(T, C),
  118:                 true = quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, C}),
  119:                 Parent ! {queued_acquisition, self(), Ref}
  120:             end),
  121:             Ref = receive {queued_acquisition, Consumer, R} -> R
  122:             after 1000 -> ct:fail(acquisition_not_queued) end,
  123:             receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Consumer, normal} -> ok
  124:             after 1000 -> ct:fail(queued_caller_not_stopped) end,
  125:             %% Delivery evidence fixes C's queued request before A's release.
  126:             %% C will evict A and register an initially-zero counter. A's old
  127:             %% zero notice no longer owns a retained contact at that point.
  128:             {messages, Messages} = process_info(T, messages),
  129:             true = lists:member({peer_contact, Consumer, Ref, C}, Messages),
  130:             true = quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A})
  131:         after ok = sys:resume(T) end,
  132:         capacity_released(T),
  133:         {ok, _} = contact(T, B)
  134:     after
  135:         unsubscribe_if_present(A),
  136:         unsubscribe_if_present(B),
  137:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T})
  138:     end.
  139: 
  140: withdrawn_contact_releases_waiting_observers(_Config) ->
  141:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
  142:     {A, KeyA} = install_contact(),
  143:     {B, KeyB} = install_contact(),
  144:     {C, _} = install_contact(),
  145:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
  146:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, B}),
  147:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, C}),
  148:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T}),
  149:     try
  150:         {ok, Old} = contact(T, A),
  151:         {blocked, capacity} = contact(T, B),
  152:         install_contact(A, KeyA, 2, []),
  153:         false = quod_directory:node_contact_current(Old),
  154:         %% The committed assignment can remain desired after withdrawal.
  155:         %% Its existing route-change acquisition must retire unusable custody
  156:         %% and wake B even though A's tracked interest is still installed.
  157:         unknown = contact(T, A),
  158:         capacity_released(T),
  159:         {ok, _} = contact(T, B),
  160:         {blocked, capacity} = contact(T, C),
  161:         install_contact(B, KeyB, 2, []),
  162:         %% Pressure also collects a stale contact before its own observer
  163:         %% processes the route-change notice; current expired leases differ.
  164:         {ok, _} = contact(T, C)
  165:     after
  166:         unsubscribe_if_present(A),
  167:         unsubscribe_if_present(B),
  168:         unsubscribe_if_present(C),
  169:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T})
  170:     end.
  171: 
  172: idle_contact_survives_until_acquisition_pressure(_Config) ->
  173:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
  174:     {A, _} = install_contact(),
  175:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
  176:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T}),
  177:     {ok, Contact} = contact(T, A),
  178:     true = quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
  179:     capacity_released(T),
  180:     ok = quod_directory:expire(maps:get(expiry, Contact)),
  181:     unknown = quod_directory:node_transport_route(A),
  182:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
  183:     {ok, Contact} = contact(T, A),
  184:     true = quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
  185:     capacity_released(T),
  186:     {B, _} = install_contact(),
  187:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, B}),
  188:     try
  189:         {ok, _} = contact(T, B),
  190:         %% Pressure may discard an idle contact, but an expired route cannot
  191:         %% recreate it. No directory renewal or private copy repairs the read.
  192:         true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, A}),
  193:         unknown = contact(T, A)
  194:     after
  195:         unsubscribe_if_present(A),
  196:         unsubscribe_if_present(B),
  197:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_observation_capacity, T})
  198:     end.
  199: 
  200: node_key_rotation_replaces_the_retained_slot(_Config) ->
  201:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
  202:     {Host, Key} = install_contact(),
  203:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Host}),
  204:     try
  205:         {ok, Old} = contact(T, Host),
  206:         Key = maps:get(node_key, Old),
  207:         NextKey = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  208:         install_contact(Host, NextKey, 2),
  209:         Owner = quod_reg:where({directory, node}),
  210:         receive {node_identity_route_changed, Owner, Host} -> ok
  211:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(tracked_route_event_not_delivered) end,
  212:         {ok, Current} = contact(T, Host),
  213:         NextKey = maps:get(node_key, Current),
  214:         false = quod_directory:node_contact_current(Old),
  215:         true = quod_directory:node_contact_current(Current),
  216:         %% The node actor still has exactly one tracked counter and slot.
  217:         1 = gproc:lookup_value({rc, l, {node_identity_route, Host}}),
  218:         {ok, Current} = contact(T, Host)
  219:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Host}) end.
  220: 
  221: install_contact() ->
  222:     Key = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  223:     Ns = <<"peer-capacity:", (binary:encode_hex(Key))/binary>>,
  224:     Host = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, crypto:hash(sha256, Ns), node},
  225:     install_contact(Host, Key, 1),
  226:     {Host, Key}.
  227: 
  228: install_contact({agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, _} = Host, Key, Generation) ->
  229:     install_contact(Host, Key, Generation, [{Ns, Anchor, observer, node}]).
  230: 
  231: install_contact(Host, Key, Generation, Hosted) ->
  232:     {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Host),
  233:     {ok, _} = quod_directory:install_generation(
  234:         #{author => {node_actor, Blob}, node_key => Key,
  235:           endpoint => {"127.0.0.1", 14599}, epoch => 1, generation => Generation,
  236:           page => 0, last => true, hosted => Hosted}),
  237:     ok.
  238: 
  239: contact(T, Host) ->
  240:     Ref = quod_quic:peer_contact(T, Host),
  241:     receive {Ref, {peer_contact, T, Host, Result}} -> Result
  242:     after 1000 -> ct:fail(no_contact_snapshot) end.
  243: 
  244: capacity_released(T) ->
  245:     receive {peer_observation_capacity, T, available} -> ok
  246:     after 1000 -> ct:fail(no_capacity_release_notification) end.
  247: 
  248: unsubscribe_if_present(Host) ->
  249:     case lists:member(self(), quod_reg:tracked_subscribers({node_identity_route, Host})) of
  250:         true -> quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Host});
  251:         false -> ok
  252:     end.
